title: FBI
description:
S03 E07 — Discord
The team hunts a killer who is fatally shooting seemingly unrelated targets; new agent Tiffany Wallace experiences tension between her work as an FBI agent and the responsibility she feels to her community as a Black woman.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E08 — Walk the Line
After a bomb leaves three people dead, the team presses a reluctant informant to gather information from his close friends who are under suspicion; OA and his girlfriend clash over where the informant's rights lie.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E09 — Leverage
When a reporter is kidnapped and held without a ransom demand, the team must dig into her past relationships in order to pin down her assailant's motive; Isobel's relationship comes under fire when the case makes a connection to her boyfriend.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E07 — Ready or Not
Maggie returns from medical leave and helps the team investigate two homicides: a law student and a young man with possible gang ties; an inadvertent revelation from Maggie causes OA to worry that she is rushing back into the job too quickly.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E08 — Into the Fire
When a deadly truck heist arms the killers with enough ammonium nitrate to construct a massive bomb, the team discovers a link to a terrorist group Maggie is working to infiltrate.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E09 — Fortunate Son
A teen shows up at FBI headquarters with a large bag of fentanyl, seeking the team's protection from the men who shot his father; Nina goes to Scola with a proposal he is hesitant to accept.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E10 — Second Life
The abduction of a young woman leads the team back to a cold case from 18 years ago, which pushes Isobel to reconnect with her old partner Jake and take another shot at solving one of her first cases at the bureau.

title: Air Force One
description: Demanding the release of a political prisoner, a terrorist and his gang hijack the U.S. president's plane.

title: The Fugitive
description: A U.S. marshal hunts a doctor on the run who was wrongfully accused and convicted of murdering his wife.

title: NHL on TNT Face Off
description: Anson Carter, Paul Bissonnette, Henrik Lundqvist and Liam McHugh present pregame coverage.

title: NHL Hockey
description:
New York Rangers at Detroit Red Wings
The Detroit Red Wings host the New York Rangers at Little Caesars Arena in Detroit, Michigan. New York earned a 4-1 victory over Detroit in April 2026. These Original Six rivals square off to open a Metropolitan and Atlantic division clash.

title: NHL Hockey
description:
St. Louis Blues at Dallas Stars
The Dallas Stars face the St. Louis Blues in a Central Division battle at American Airlines Center. This matchup is the opening game of the regular-season for both teams. In their previous regular-season meeting, the Stars beat the Blues 5-4.

title: NHL Post-Game on TNT
description: Liam McHugh, Anson Carter and Paul Bissonnette recap the night in the NHL.

title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis
description:
S01 E03 — Bad Romance
NHL forward Wyatt Johnston and Howie Mandel set up NHL defenseman Lian Bichsel at a restaurant where a romantic proposal meltdown turns him into the unwitting villain.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E11 — Heroes
The team jumps into action when analyst Kelly Moran is taken hostage.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E12 — Breakdown
After a mysterious bioweapon leaves two MTA workers dead and one injured, the team rushes to determine who is behind the attack and the location of their next target; Jubal's past demons begin to surface.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E13 — Protégé
The team investigates the murder of a professional informant after he's found dead outside an abandoned factory; Maggie reconnects with an old colleague and mentor.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E10 — Checks and Balances
The team must track down two assailants who wear animal masks while committing armed robberies; Tiffany and Scola butt heads on whether to accept the local NYPD's offer to help in the investigation.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E11 — Brother's Keeper
After a man is killed by an explosive package shipped to his home, the team attempts to capture the sender and intercept his latest deadly parcel; Maggie struggles to trust her younger sister.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E12 — Fathers and Sons
The team rushes to track down two doctors abducted by a desperate father willing to do anything to save his son; Jubal's uncertainty in his family life affects his judgment during the hostage situation.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E13 — Short Squeeze
When the CEO of a major brokerage firm is killed while surrounded by protesters, the team looks into who had the most to lose from his company's perceived manipulations; Scola's previous Wall Street career and the reasons he left come to light.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E14 — Trigger Effect
While investigating a mass casualty incident at a New York City restaurant, the team scrambles to determine if it was racially motivated and if there was more than one gunman; Maggie starts to notice troubling behavior from her co-worker Elise.

title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
description: Black Manta wields the power of the mythic Black Trident to unleash an ancient and malevolent force. Hoping to end his reign of terror, Aquaman forges an unlikely alliance with his brother to protect their kingdom and save the world from destruction.

title: Big 12 Football Pregame
description: Champ Bailey, Takeo Spikes, Victor Cruz and Adam Lefkoe preview the Big 12 football game of the week.

title: College Football
description:
West Virginia at Iowa State
From Jack Trice Stadium in Ames, Iowa.

title: Big 12 Football Postgame
description: Champ Bailey, Takeo Spikes, Victor Cruz and Adam Lefkoe wrap up the night in the Big 12.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E05 — Clean Slate
The team searches for a young girl who was kidnapped from a cabin during a family vacation; Maggie questions her relationship with Nestor when she learns he hasn't been completely honest with her.

title: Aquaman
description: Aquaman must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan to save the underwater city of Atlantis -- and the surface world -- from his power-hungry brother.

title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
description:
S04 E43
The Dogs and Death Riders take on the Bang Bang Gang in an eight-man tag.

description:
USA vs. Mexico
From State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Ariz.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E02 — Unreasonable Doubt
The team races to stop an active serial killer after three women are found weighted down at the bottom of a lake; Jubal looks into an old closed case after there are multiple similarities to the recent victims.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E03 — Liar's Poker
When the leader of a drug cartel and one of the world's most wanted men is apprehended by the team, the entire FBI headquarters is put at risk when his henchmen unveil a plot to free him; Isobel must make a difficult decision.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E04 — Crazy Love
A shooting at a quinceañera leaves two dead, but the team believes they may not have been the intended targets; Maggie is conflicted as the team decides the best plan of action for using a witness to take down their suspect.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E15 — Straight Flush
When five prominent men are gunned down at a trendy New York restaurant, the team's investigation brings them into contact with a lieutenant in Antonio Vargas' cartel, triggering a showdown between Isobel and Vargas.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E01 — All That Glitters
After a young woman is killed on her way home from a lavish yacht party, the team investigates who she was and how she came to be at the event.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E02 — Hacktivist
Maggie, OA and the team must stop a hacker who is disabling life-saving equipment in several New York City hospitals; Jubal's son waits for important surgery at one of the impacted hospitals.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E03 — Trauma
The team finds a connection between bombings and a private veterans' club in New York City; Isobel tells a reluctant OA to recruit a former Army buddy for intel.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E04 — Know Thyself
The team hunts for a serial killer who is targeting young, homeless men; Tiffany and Scola don't see eye to eye on how to handle the case.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E06 — Uncovered
The team must infiltrate a drug trafficking gang after the robbery of a chemical plant leaves two customs agents dead; Nestor offers his help on the case, giving Maggie new insight into his character.

title: The Batman
description: Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues. As the scale of the perpetrator's plans become clear, he must bring justice to the abuse of power and corruption that plagues the metropolis.

title: Training Day
description: A rookie police officer meets a corrupt Los Angeles narcotics detective who wants to include him in his schemes.

title: The Accountant
description: A Treasury agent (J.K. Simmons) closes in on a brilliant freelance accountant (Ben Affleck) who works for dangerous criminal organizations.

title: The Equalizer 3
description: Finding himself at home in Southern Italy, former operative Robert McCall soon discovers his new friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall becomes their protector by taking on the mafia.

title: High Value Target: The Hunt for Saddam
description:
S01 E08 — Debriefing the President
John becomes a pariah in Washington by trying to save Saddam and warning about the coming threat of Iran. A meeting in the White House gives John one last chance to convince President Bush to alter the course of the Middle East.

title: The Matrix Resurrections
description: If Mr. Anderson, aka Neo, has learned anything, it's that choice, while an illusion, is the only way out of -- or into -- the Matrix. Neo knows what he has to do, but what he doesn't yet know is that the Matrix is now stronger and far more dangerous.

title: Charmed
description:
S02 E12 — Awakened
Prue and Phoebe break a code of conduct to cure Piper when she is hospitalized with a deadly disease, but the illness is spread to other patients.

title: Charmed
description:
S02 E13 — Animal Pragmatism
Phoebe attempts to reverse the spell that turned animals into good-looking dates for her study group, creating a virtual zoo at the club.

title: Charmed
description:
S02 E14 — Pardon My Past
Phoebe travels to 1924 and confronts an immortal warlock (Tyler Christopher) who forced her to destroy Prue and Piper in a past life.

title: Charmed
description:
S02 E15 — Give Me a Sign
Criminal mastermind Bane (Antonio Sabato Jr.) kidnaps Prue and makes her protect him from a powerful demon.

title: Charmed
description:
S02 E16 — Murphy's Luck
After Prue rescues an unlucky woman who is being tormented by a Darklighter, she is beset by telepathic messages telling her to commit suicide.

title: Charmed
description:
S02 E17 — How to Make a Quilt Out of Americans
An old family friend appeals to Piper, Phoebe and Prue to stop a demon who steals the skin from corpses; Piper doesn't want to be a witch anymore.

title: Charmed
description:
S02 E18 — Chick Flick
A demon emancipates celluloid monsters from the confines of the silver screen to kill Phoebe, Piper and Prue.

title: Charmed
description:
S02 E19 — Ex Libris
Phoebe helps the ghost of a student who was killed to prevent the publication of her thesis on evil; the Goo Goo Dolls perform at Piper's nightclub.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E10 — Forever Blue
After Rush is given clues to an unsolved cop killing, she reopens the case; her investigation uncovers a secret that may have motivated someone unexpected to murder the patrolman.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E11 — The Red and the Blue
The reopening of the case of a male singer's 2000 murder requires Lilly and reluctant Scotty to travel to Knoxville, Tenn., to delve into the country music world.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E12 — Knuckle Up
Lilly reopens the 2006 case of a college-bound man's disappearance after his sister finds an Internet video of him in the underground subculture of bare-knuckle brawling.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E13 — Blackout
When new evidence suggests murder, Lilly and Scotty reopen the 1998 case of a wealthy family matriarch (Donna Mills), whose death was originally ruled an accident.

title: Cold Case
description:

Miller re-examines a case that has haunted her for years as she searches for the link between two murders that happened at the exact same time.
